comment: Independent C runtime witness for dungeon.c ledger_no() with a trap destination of {-1, -1}. A wished magic portal keeps maketrap()'s dst, so when the kitten walks onto it teleport.c mlevel_tele_trap() passes ledger_no() a dnum of -1 and C reads svd.dungeons[-1].ledger_start, which in the recorder's build is svc.context.jingle[0..3]. The fifth improvised flute tune of this seed has one note (rnd(5)=1 at music.c:742), the only length for which migrate_to_level() finds a real level instead of panicking; the kitten then "disappears out of sight" and play continues.
